From this moment forward, your body's natural
powers of repair, rebuilding, and regeneration
are becoming stronger and more effective.

Your physical body contains the knowledge
and biological patterns from which
its healthy structures were originally formed.

These patterns guide your body's natural
processes of cellular renewal, repair,
and organized tissue growth.

Whenever any part of your body is injured,
damaged, weakened, or missing,
your regenerative processes will respond,
working toward the restoration
of its healthy form and function.

Bring your awareness to the remarkable
ability of living cells to renew,
multiply, specialize, and work together
to create healthy tissue.

Your body's natural regenerative signals
coordinate these processes,
directing rebuilding where it is needed.

Healthy circulation provides the oxygen
and nourishment required for this work,
while your body's maintenance systems
clear away damaged and unnecessary material.

New healthy tissue forms in the proper
structure, position, and organization,
restoring strength, connection, and function.

Every part of this process works in harmony
with the rest of your physical body.

Regeneration proceeds accurately,
creating what is needed and completing
its work when the proper structure is restored.

From this moment forward, this pattern
of repair, reconstruction, and regeneration
is permanently established within you.

Whether awake, resting, or sleeping,
your body's natural regenerative processes
continue automatically, without conscious effort.

Whenever you wish to direct additional
regenerative activity toward a particular area,
close your eyes and focus your attention
on the part you wish to restore.

Picture its complete, healthy form
and the function it is designed to perform.

If its precise internal structure is unknown,
allow your body's natural intelligence
to guide the rebuilding process.

Inhale deeply and gently hold your breath.

Think or say in your mind, "Plus Build Live."

Then exhale slowly through your mouth
and open your eyes.

Your entire physical system will respond,
directing its coordinated processes
of repair, rebuilding, and regeneration
toward the selected area.

Each time you use Plus Build Live,
directing this regenerative pattern
becomes easier, faster, and more effective.

Your body's natural powers of regeneration
will continue working automatically,
restoring healthy structure and function
wherever rebuilding is needed.
